verdict.rationale: React is an open-source library on GitHub. Developers install it in their own build toolchain and run it on their own infrastructure: rendering on their own Node server, or deploying to a CDN or static host without any vendor service. Nothing depends on a hosted vendor platform, so self-hosting the core product is inherent to how it ships. missing for 10: a first-party statement of the open-source license (the MIT relicensing appears only in community discussion), explicit first-party documentation framing React as self-hostable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: React can also render on the server using Node
